resources.string: Lets the remote\'s Home button open Lumbina (holding it opens the quick menu) and turns the mic button into voice input.
No sound from the remote\'s microphone
The remote\'s microphone is turned off in the firmware. See “Diagnostics” in Lumbina\'s settings
Search didn\'t open. Change “Where to search” in “Widgets” in Lumbina\'s settings
Nowhere to type “%1$s”. Select a text field first
The speech service has no key: enter it in “Voice input” in Lumbina\'s settings
The speech service didn\'t accept the key: check it in “Voice input” in Lumbina\'s settings
Your speech service account is out of funds. Top it up on the service\'s website
The speech service won\'t work with this key. Check its permissions and billing on the service\'s website
The speech service isn\'t available in your country. Choose another in “Voice input”
The speech service isn\'t working right now (error %1$d). Try again later
Too many requests to the speech service. Wait a minute
The remote\'s sound isn\'t reaching the app. Check “Access” in Lumbina\'s settings
Speech recognition isn\'t responding. Check your internet connection
Lumbina\'s voice input isn\'t ready: open Lumbina and check “Voice input” in its settings
Apps you open will show up here.
Which one: %1$s? Say the name again, more exactly
This device does not allow that
Volume, picture and power stay on the remote’s buttons
The app “%1$s” started recording. Let it hear the remote?
Done. Start recording in the app once more.
◀ ▶ choose · OK switch · holding OK closes the app · Back leave
